assumptions: Account ID is not discoverable via a documented API endpoint in the source, so it is collected as a connection field and templated into the users path.
Base URL uses the US region https://api.1password.com; accounts in Canada, Europe or ent regions use a different documented base URL which the runtime must allow to be configured.
Listing users requires the users.view scope; the source shows this scope on tokens but does not explicitly map scopes to endpoints.
Omitting filter returns both active and suspended users; no deleted users are available via the API.
Pagination ends when next_page_token is omitted; a missing results field is treated as an empty page.
User records expose no role, user type, or last-active field, so those fields are null and usage is unavailable.
STATE_UNSPECIFIED (e.g. pending confirmation or recovery) is mapped to pending; missing state is treated as unknown by the runtime.
Rate-limit headers and 100 requests per minute limit are as documented for the Users API; OAuth token endpoints have separate shared limits.
